text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Workplace Safety and Health (Compoundable Offences) Regulations. Compoundable offences
Any offence under the Act and the regulations, except sections 21(7) and 52, may be compounded by the Authority in accordance with section 55(1). [S 56/2018]
